predeclared.population: two existing course-integration and registry-recovery receipts
predeclared.stopping_rule: one complete run; no relabeling or tuning
predeclared.baseline: PR179 natural-language parser and original first-hit evaluator with bind_run=False
predeclared.candidate: same PR179 parser and its default run-bound evaluator
predeclared.pass: exact disposition; for positive/contradicted answers, exact scalar type and value, bound receipt, expected JSON path and source byte span; for abstain/clarify, no answer/citation
predeclared.ambiguity: Every supported field without a named run requires clarify_run even when only one run records the field. Named run with unspecified field requires clarify_field. A specifically requested unreported quantity requires abstain.
predeclared.passage_control: On positive cases only compare top-two raw passage hits from base and head lexical implementations. Require source/version, byte range, excerpt hash and enclosed expected value.
predeclared.primary_gate: More exact correct decisions than baseline, zero new errors. Report absolute misses even on positive differential.
limitations: Freshly authored public synthetic questions, source-aware and implementation-visible; no independent live traffic or blind sample.
Deliberately adversarial receipt questions; raw passage recall and full answer accuracy are separate outcomes.
